name: Copper
note: Chile and Peru are the world's two largest producers (USGS MCS 2026).
uses: Electrical wiring and electronics, construction, industrial machinery and transport; an electric vehicle and a wind turbine use several times the copper of their conventional equivalents.
why_it_matters: Chile and Peru are the two largest producers in the world and most of their concentrate is smelted abroad, above all in China; copper is the largest mineral flow by value in the region and the one the energy transition is expected to tighten first.
uses_source: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (annual; uses as summarised there) and the registry notes; curated text, no figures

hs_codes.description: Refined copper cathodes and sections of cathodes
Unrefined copper; copper anodes for electrolytic refining
